column1: Whisk the flour, baking soda and salt in a small bowl.
Beat the butter, both sugars and vanilla in a large bowl until creamy.
Beat in the eggs one at a time, then gradually mix in the flour mixture.
Stir in the chocolate chips and nuts.
Drop rounded tablespoons of dough onto ungreased baking sheets.
Cool on the sheets 2 minutes, then move to wire racks to cool completely.
